t: I have seen your flight and your dispersal from the lines.

You were surrounded by rude and low people and the Bedouins of Al-Sham (Syria), although you are the chiefs of Arabs and summit of distinction, and are of dignity as that of high nose and big hump of camel.

The sigh of my bosom can subside only when I eventually see you surrounding them as they surrounded you, and see you dislodging them from their position as they dislodged you, killing them with arrows and striking them with spears so that their forward rows might fall on the rear ones just like the thirsty camels who have been turned away from their places of drink and removed from their water-points.
